item.title: IntelArchive Weekly Digest — 16 new items · 23 November 2026
item.description:
📬 IntelArchive Weekly Digest · 23 November 2026
16 new additions to the IntelArchive Intelligence Studies Database this week, including 12 journal articles, 2 books, a book chapter and a podcast. 4 new book reviews added too.
Highlights: 📘 The Enemy of My Enemy Is My Friend: The Strategic Influence of America’s Flawed Intelligence Partnership With Reinhard Gehlen (Brandon Bernick) 📘 Stalin’s Apostles: The Cambridge Five and the Making of the Soviet Empire (Antonia Senior) 📄 ‘Espionnage Cordial’: The Secret Intelligence Service and British Spying Against French Aviation, 1925 – 1927 (James Bruce, Daniel W. B. Lomas)
📖 New review: The DGSE: A Concise History of France's Foreign Intelligence Service by Drew S. Switzer
Plus more events, conferences and calls for papers in the full digest 👇
#IntelligenceStudies #IntelligenceHistory #NationalSecurity
